lines.text: Everyone remembers when Manchester United were the most feared club on the planet.
Ferguson, Scholes, Giggs, Ronaldo, Rooney, trebles, titles, Champions League nights that made the whole world stop.
Now in 2026, they are sitting mid-table, getting booed off their own pitch, and their manager is fighting for his job before October.
How did the biggest club in England fall this far, this fast?
Stay with us, because this 10-part series is going to break down every single reason United are where they are today. And trust me, some of it will shock you.
